licence.value: Apache 2.0 (card; no LICENSE file in the weights repository)
licence.note: The licence is stated twice in the card (metadata and a 'License and use' section) and the olmOCR code on GitHub has an Apache 2.0 LICENSE file; base model Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct is Apache 2.0. The card adds: "intended for research and educational use in accordance with Ai2's Responsible Use Guidelines" (https://allenai.org/responsible-use). Apache 2.0 itself sets no such limit; the sentence states the publisher's intent.
